generate_audio_tokens_with_magnet: generate audio tokens from text conditions using the MAGNeT iterative decoding algorithm with classifier-free guidance
build_restricted_context_attention_mask: build a restricted attention mask for subcode levels with a configurable local context window size
create_stage_attention_mask: create a per-stage attention mask for a given RVQ codebook index with memory-efficient alignment
construct_spans_mask_for_masking: construct a boolean spans mask from span start indices for use in the MAGNeT masking scheme
run_least_probable_span_masking: run binary search to find the least probable overlapping spans to mask a target number of tokens
